title: Paystride Save Account Agreement — Deposits into Savings
content:
Money reaches a Paystride Save account from the linked card in three ways: a round-up sweep, an auto-save from a payroll load, or a manual transfer. The following clauses govern all three.

### Clause D1 — Account status

A deposit is booked only while the savings account status is open. A pending, frozen or closed Paystride Save account takes no deposit of any of the three kinds.

### Clause D2 — Round-ups

Round-ups save, for each card purchase, the difference to the next whole dollar times the round-up multiplier the worker chose (a purchase of a whole-dollar amount rounds up a full dollar). The day's round-ups are swept at the tier's round-up sweep time, Eastern Time, are limited to the tier's round-up daily cap — the total of round-up deposits in one calendar day — and are skipped for the day when the card balance is below the tier's round-up minimum card balance.

Worked through on hypothetical purchases:

| Purchase | Difference to the next whole dollar | Multiplier chosen | Round-up |
|---|---|---|---|
| $3.40 | $0.60 | 2 | $0.60 multiplied by 2, which is $1.20 |
| $7.00 | a full dollar, $1.00 | 1 | $1.00 |
| $12.85 | $0.15 | 3 | $0.15 multiplied by 3, which is $0.45 |

### Clause D3 — Auto-save

Auto-save takes the auto-save percentage the worker chose of each payroll load of at least the tier's auto-save minimum payroll load, rounded down to the cent. It is never taken from off-cycle loads or instant pay disbursements, and its relation to early pay follows the Paystride Save rules on holding a Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan.

Hypothetical illustration, with a chosen auto-save percentage of 15 percent:

- a payroll load of $487.35, which is at least the tier's auto-save minimum payroll load: 15 percent of $487.35 is $73.1025, rounded down to the cent, so $73.10 is saved;
- a payroll load below the minimum: no auto-save is taken;
- an off-cycle load or an instant pay disbursement of any size: no auto-save is taken.

### Clause D4 — Manual transfers

Manual transfers are at least the tier's smallest manual transfer and at most the tier's manual deposit daily limit a day.

### Clause D5 — Largest balance

A deposit that would take the balance above the tier's largest balance is skipped, never partly made. The whole deposit is skipped; no part of it is booked to fill the room left below the largest balance.

### Tier choices that bound these clauses

The round-up multiplier a worker uses in clause D2 is at most the tier's highest round-up multiplier, and the percentage used in clause D3 at most the tier's highest share of a payroll load the worker may auto-save; both are Paystride Save tier figures.
